name: row-actions-shape
description: Vibe test comparing three API shapes for secondary actions on a list row: declared data, composed controls, and a touch-only commit swipe. Prompts are identical across arms and never name a prop, the word 'swipe', or the word 'hover'.

prompts.correct: two actions (archive, delete) on each row, revealed adaptively; nothing else added
prompts.text: Build the message list for a mail app. Each row shows the sender, the subject line and the time. Every message can be archived or deleted. On a phone people expect to flick a row sideways to get at those two verbs; on a laptop the list should stay clean, so the verbs should not clutter every row. Assume `messages` (with `id`, `sender`, `subject`, `time`), `archive(id)` and `remove(id)` already exist.

prompts.cell: one destructive verb that confirms first
prompts.correct: one action (remove) whose handler awaits confirmation before removing; the row itself is not the remove
prompts.text: Build a list of uploaded files, each row showing the file name and its size. Each file can be removed, but removal is permanent, so the person has to confirm in a dialog before anything is removed. Assume `files` (with `id`, `name`, `size`), `removeFile(id)` and a `useConfirm()` hook that returns `confirm(message): Promise<boolean>` already exist.

prompts.cell: four verbs, two of them state-dependent, keyboard-only user
prompts.correct: four actions per row, read/unread and pin/unpin labels derived from state, all four reachable by keyboard without a second hand-built path
prompts.text: Build a notifications list. Each row can be marked read or unread (whichever it currently is not), pinned or unpinned, snoozed, or deleted: four verbs on every row. A colleague who uses only the keyboard must be able to do all four on any row. Assume `notifications` (with `id`, `title`, `isRead`, `isPinned`), `markRead(id, isRead)`, `pin(id, isPinned)`, `snooze(id)` and `remove(id)` already exist.

prompts.correct: plain navigating rows; no actions, no reveal setting
prompts.text: Build the Settings screen's list: Account, Notifications, Privacy and About. Each row opens its page. Nothing happens to a row other than opening it. Assume `navigate(path)` already exists.

recall.note: Behavior described, prop names deliberately unnamed. The agent writes the API it expects for p1, p2 and p3 in one pass; one agent per sample, three samples. Deliberate deviation from one-agent-per-prompt, recorded in PLAN.md caveats.
